name: Tales of the Brine
title: SIEGELINE
tagline: Hold the Gullwake. The tide has turned green, and everything the sea swallowed is crawling back up the beach.
weaponHelp: Long Tom, the fort's cannon: hold and drag back to aim, release to fire

abilityDesc.rally: Crew sings: +35% speed, faster attacks, heals 15% · {t}s · {cd}s

armTarget: Tap the beach where the Broadside should land

results.closeGate: The Grotto had only {hp} left. So close.
results.closeBoss: Mother Fathom was down to {pct}%. So close.

tips.weapon: Tip: Long Tom reloads on its own. Fire it often, one cannonball can scatter a whole pack.
tips.big: Tip: Trolls and the Kelpie hit hard. Hold them with Hatchguards while Blackpowders and Long Tom wear them down.
tips.bloater: Tip: Pufferghasts burst when they die. Pop them from range with Blackpowders or Long Tom, not among your crew.
tips.spitter: Tip: Inkspitters hide behind the horde. Rope Rats reach them fast.
tips.send: Tip: send crew steadily. Powder you don't spend is wasted when the store is full.
tips.general: Tip: upgrades from the Quartermaster carry over to every stage. Replays earn doubloons too.

armoury.title: Quartermaster
armoury.heroDesc: HP {hp} · DMG {d} · Flare pistol stuns nearby monsters

regionCleared.title: Saltwick Cove is safe
regionCleared.text: Mother Fathom sinks back into the deep. The course to the Fogbanks opens in the next update. Replay stages for stars and upgrades until then.
